programs.title: Skyfall
programs.desc: When James Bond's (Daniel Craig) latest assignment goes terribly wrong, it leads to a calamitous turn of events: Undercover agents around the world are exposed, and MI6 is attacked, forcing M (Judi Dench) to relocate the agency. With MI6 now compromised inside and out, M turns to the one man she can trust: Bond. Aided only by a field agent (Naomie Harris), Bond takes to the shadows and follows a trail to Silva (Javier Bardem), a man from M's past who wants to settle an old score.

programs.title: Second Chances
programs.desc: The past comes back to haunt a former journalist (Melissa George) who let a serial killer slip through her fingers.

programs.title: Killer Coworker
programs.desc: When a spa employee is framed for the murder of a jealous co-worker, she must uncover the culprit before she becomes the next victim.

programs.title: We Three Kings
programs.desc: A retired musician hatches a plan to bring his three daughters home for Christmas for the first time since their mother's death. Holiday songs and old memories soon make the estranged siblings realize that life is better when they're all together.

programs.title: All Light, Everywhere
programs.desc: Filmmaker Theo Anthony offers a far-ranging look at the biases in how people see things, focusing on the recorded image.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: When an explosion takes place near the hospital, Bash runs toward the danger; when a schoolgirl is brought into the hospital in cardiac arrest, Theo does everything he can to save her.
